run_video_pose_demo: run the video pose estimation demo comparing original and torch compiled models side by side
run_batch_pose_inference: run batch top-down pose estimation on a list of images with bounding boxes
run_detector_inference: run object detection inference on images using an mmdet detector model
run_pose_visualization: run pose estimation and visualize predicted keypoints and heatmaps on video frames
run_video_comparison: run a video processing pipeline that compares original vs compiled pose model inference speed
